When someone quits a job, they want to see the company go under. When they leave a social network, they want to see it fade into obscurity. When people get dumped they'd like to think of their ex as being miserable afterwards. And it extends to the rest of the world. Every generation is constantly talking about the imminent collapse of civilization, whether from a religious, political, or economic perspective. Yet it never happens.
